invariant_bindings.invariant_text: `get(k)` on an expired entry MUST return None AND remove the stale entry from the store (read-through eviction).
The store size MUST never exceed MAX_CACHE_SIZE after any `set`; eviction order is strict LRU (least recently accessed key first).
After `set(k, v)`, a subsequent `get(k)` within the TTL window MUST return the stored `v` (write-then-read consistency).
